_comment: Example policy. Replace it with yours before you deploy. Every key here is optional; Claude Code merges this above user and project settings, and a user cannot override what it sets.

permissions._comment: Blocking bypass mode is the one setting most teams want first. It stops --dangerously-skip-permissions from turning every prompt off.

_env_comment: Environment variables forced on every session on this machine.
_claudeMd_comment: Text appended to every session's context, whatever the project. Keep it short; it costs tokens on every single turn.
_hooks_comment: Hooks defined here run for everyone and cannot be removed by a user. Point them at a root-owned script, not at a path inside a user's home, or the guarantee is only as strong as that file's permissions.
